# `get_enabled_plan`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the enabled legacy autosave plans with progress and estimates.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit and 32-bit builds); it is a mutator because the estimate path writes shared caches. |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xb53e0, FormatPlans @0x3097c0 (64-bit build) |

Returns only the enabled legacy plans, with the same fields as get_plan (progress flag set). Disabled targets inside an enabled plan are still listed; enabled does not establish that the plan is running. No request parameters are read.

Side effects: Copies the global plan map under its lock. Estimating enabled plans refreshes shared camera-information caches (64-bit build) and writes to the logger, which can append or rotate log files. No plan is started and no hardware is moved. Camera-read failures are not turned into errors.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_enabled_plan"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 268 | The plan loader thread is running | `operation is in progress` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, all - Enabled plans:

```json
{"id":41,"method":"get_enabled_plan"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_enabled_plan","result":[{"id":1,"plan_name":"Example plan","merid_flip":true,"mount_go_home":true,"focuser_go_home":false,"shutdown_pi":false,"start_guide":true,"close_cooler":true,"wait_cooling":true,"enable":true,"left_size_m":800.5,"left_time_sec":5400,"total_time_sec":5400,"cur_id":1,"start_time":{"type":"date","hour":21},"end_time":{"type":"dawn"},"targets":[{"delay_first":0,"delay_between_frame":0,"id":1,"capture_index":0,"extra_sec_per_target":0,"left_time_sec":5400,"total_time_sec":5400,"code":0,"enable":true,"group_by_slot":true,"target_name":"Example target","target_original_img":"","target_original_name":"","real_start_date":"","real_end_date":"","obj_type":"","left_size_m":800.5,"error":"no error","cur_id":1,"target_coord":[12,30],"seqs":[{"id":1,"filter":0,"gain":80,"bin":1,"repeat":30,"lapsed":0,"capture_index":0,"type":"light","suffix":"","exp":10,"enable":true,"autoexp":false}]}]}],"code":0,"id":41}
```

Reply, ok-empty:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_enabled_plan","result":[],"code":0,"id":43}
```
